decisionSummary: First governed release of Claude-Melusina. The repository carries exactly two heads and both are the same commit, so there is no divergent line to reconcile and no preserved branch to adopt: dev-publish is selected and main is its identical baseline. The selected head completes two architectural changes and one release-integrity fix. (1) Claude Code, its loader and its exact shared-library closure are sealed into the signed SPK and detected read-only from the package root; the previous design had the operator upload a runtime tarball into the grain's /var at setup time, and that path, its verifier and its build tool are deleted rather than retained as a fallback. (2) Authentication is Claude Code's own browser-link OAuth, replacing the session-only pasted API key removed in this same line: the grain surfaces only the one-time login URL, forwards the pasted code straight to the CLI's stdin, and never persists or journals it, while HOME stays pinned at /var/home so the CLI's own credential and resumable session state survive a grain restart. (3) The runtime archive pin bound a tarball packed without a fixed mtime or gzip -n, so its digest recorded when the archive was assembled rather than what it contained and could not be regenerated once the original file was gone; the same reviewed members are now repacked byte-reproducibly and re-pinned. The upstream provenance anchor is unchanged and still enforced separately: bin/claude hashes to the digest verified against Anthropic's signed release manifest. This release also adds PowerBox connections to arbitrary other grains, reusing the vendored melusina-http-component capability lifecycle against a wildcard UiView descriptor, with permission level chosen in Sandstorm's own grain-picker rather than in app UI.
